Name: Muted Seeds for 1.6 unofficial update
Author: HoneyKitten66
Description:
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Kayyteee/about-me]Kayyteee[/url] made 3 wonderfull mods making the seeds & fertilizer & fruit tree saplings have a more town down look.
I continued to use the mods in 1.6 but felt that the new seeds added in 1.6 didn't quite fit with the vibe.
I'm not certain if they should look the same as all the other seeds or not but I know that this is how I wanted them to look.


[b][u]Please note[/u]:
[/b]⠀•⠀This mod ONLY includes the new seeds added in 1.6, you'll still need [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Kayyteee/about-me]Kayyteee[/url]﻿'s original mod for this to work properly.
⠀•⠀All three Muted mods were made for 1.5 but work just fine with 1.6 without any need for them to be updated.


[b][u]Other mod required[/u]: [/b]
⠀•⠀[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16777]Muted Seeds[/url]


[b][u]Kayytee's other mods that match this one[/u]:[/b]
⠀•⠀[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16779]Muted Saplings[/url]
⠀•⠀[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16780]Muted Boosts[/url]


[b][u]Install Instructions[/u]: [/b]
⠀•⠀Place the folder '[CP] Muted Seeds' from the original mod into into your mod folder.
⠀•⠀Place the folder '[CP] Muted Seeds for 1.6' from this mod into your mod folder next to it.
(both mods are required)
